description: One question, answered from tool results (plan -> act -> answer; code validates).

answerable.description: False if the tools cannot answer it (missing data, future dates, out of scope); then leave value and choice null
answerable.title: Answerable

choice.description: For yes/no or category questions: the answer word (e.g. 'yes', 'backwardation', 'uptrend'), otherwise null
choice.title: Choice

citations.description: Result ids that support the answer, e.g. ['T2']
citations.title: Citations

plan.description: 1-4 short steps: which tools you will call and why (no numbers)
plan.title: Plan

value.description: The single number that answers the question, copied from a cited tool result (fractions as given, e.g. 0.074), or null
value.title: Value

title: ResearchAnswer
